name: Reflective
intro: Welcome to this space of reflection.
Here, there are no right answers. Only honest ones.
Let your breathing slow. Let the noise of the day fade.
We're going to explore some questions together.
You don't have to answer out loud. Just let the questions land.
See what surfaces. Trust what comes.
body: Ask yourself quietly: How am I really doing?
Not the answer you give to others. The real one.
Sit with it. Whatever it is, it's valid.
You don't have to fix how you feel. Just acknowledge it.
Being honest with yourself is the beginning of everything.
What has been asking for your attention that you've been avoiding?
It might be a feeling. A conversation. A decision.
Avoidance doesn't make things disappear. It just makes them heavier.
What would it feel like to gently turn toward it instead of away?
You don't have to act. Just look.
Think about what matters most to you. Not what should matter. What actually does.
Are your days aligned with that? Even a little?
If not, that's not failure. That's awareness. And awareness is the first step.
What's one tiny thing you could do tomorrow that would move you closer?
Hold that thought. It's a seed.
Who have you been lately? Not who you want to be. Who have you actually been?
Have you been kind to yourself? Have you been present?
If the answer is no, that's okay. You're noticing now.
Every moment is a chance to choose differently.
What would you like to choose next?
Imagine yourself one year from now.
What do you hope has changed? What do you hope has stayed the same?
That future version of you is being shaped right now, in these quiet moments.
What message would you send them? What would you want them to know?
Sit with that connection. Past you, present you, future you. All one.
closing: There's no need to resolve everything today.
The questions you've asked will continue to work inside you, even after this session ends.
Take a deep breath and slowly return to the room.
Open your eyes when you're ready. You've done something brave today.
